import java.util.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 1000005;
    static final long mod1 = 998244353L;
    static final long mod2 = 1000000007L;
    static long[] st = new long[15];
    static String[] good = new String[MAXN];
    static int N, number;
    static List<String>[] lenn = new ArrayList[7];
    static List<Long>[][] ok = new ArrayList[7][7];
    static long[][] sum = new long[7][7];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            lenn[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 7; j++) {
                ok[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }
    }

    static long goal(String s) {
        long res = 0;
        for (char c : s.toCharArray()) {
            res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
        }
        return res;
    }

    static BigInteger get_value(String cur, int max_len, int number, List<String>[] lenn, List<Long>[][] ok, long[][] sum) {
        if (max_len == -1) return BigInteger.ZERO;
        int L = max_len / 2;
        int R = max_len - L;
        if (max_len == 1) {
            L = 1;
            R = 0;
        }
        BigInteger ans = BigInteger.valueOf(number).subtract(BigInteger.valueOf(goal(cur))).add(BigInteger.valueOf(mod1).pow(2)).mod(BigInteger.valueOf(mod1));
        number++;
        for (String lef : lenn[L]) {
            long c = goal(cur + lef) % mod1;
            ans = ans.add(BigInteger.valueOf(-c).add(BigInteger.valueOf(number)).add(BigInteger.valueOf(mod1).pow(2)).mod(BigInteger.valueOf(mod1)));
            number++;
            if (lef.length() == L) {
                long c_mod = c;
                for (int oth = 1; oth <= R; ++oth) {
                    long cnst = (-c_mod * st[oth] + number + mod1 * mod1) % mod1;
                    int to = lowerBound(ok[R][oth], mod1 - cnst);
                    long size = ok[R][oth].size();
                    long sumVal = sum[R][oth];
                    ans = ans.add(BigInteger.valueOf(size).multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(cnst)).add(BigInteger.valueOf(sumVal)).subtract(BigInteger.valueOf(mod1).multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(size - to))));
                }
                number += lenn[R].size();
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        N = String.valueOf(n).length();
        st[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 14; ++i) st[i] = st[i - 1] * 10;

        String s = String.valueOf(n);
        StringBuilder cur = new StringBuilder();

        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; ++i) {
            good[i] = String.valueOf(i);
            String now = good[i];
            while (now.length() <= 6) {
                lenn[now.length()].add(now);
                now = "0" + now;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; ++i) {
            for (String key : lenn[i - 1]) {
                lenn[i].add(key);
            }
            Collections.sort(lenn[i]);
            for (int j = 0; j < lenn[i].size(); ++j) {
                String keyStr = lenn[i].get(j);
                long keyVal = goal(keyStr);
                int lenKey = keyStr.length();
                long val = (j - keyVal + mod1) % mod1;
                ok[i][lenKey].add(val);
            }
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
                Collections.sort(ok[i][j]);
                long total = 0;
                for (long key : ok[i][j]) total += key;
                sum[i][j] = total;
            }
        }

        List<Pair> Q = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= 9; ++j) {
                if (j == s.charAt(i) - '0') continue;
                if (i == 0 && j == 0) continue;
                cur.setLength(0);
                cur.append(s.substring(0, i));
                cur.append((char) ('0' + j));
                String nowStr = cur.toString();
                int remaining = s.length() - i - 1;
                if (j <= s.charAt(i) - '0') {
                    Q.add(new Pair(nowStr, remaining));
                } else {
                    Q.add(new Pair(nowStr, remaining - 1));
                }
            }
            cur.setLength(0);
            cur.append(s.substring(0, i));
            cur.append(s.charAt(i));
            Q.add(new Pair(cur.toString(), 0));
        }

        Collections.sort(Q, Comparator.comparing(p -> p.first));
        long ans = 0;
        int number = 1;
        for (Pair key : Q) {
            String firstStr = key.first;
            int lenFirst = firstStr.length();
            if (s.charAt(lenFirst - 1) == firstStr.charAt(lenFirst - 1)) {
                long temp = (BigInteger.valueOf(-goal(firstStr)).add(BigInteger.valueOf(number)).add(BigInteger.valueOf(mod1).pow(2))).mod(BigInteger.valueOf(mod1)).longValue();
                ans += temp;
                number++;
                continue;
            }
            ans += get_value(firstStr, key.second, number, lenn, ok, sum).longValue();
            number++;
        }
        ans %= mod2;
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }

    static class Pair {
        String first;
        int second;

        Pair(String first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }
}
